title: PP 10043 implementation guidance and military-civil fusion criteria (State Dept, Oct 2025–present)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Records created or issued from October 1, 2025 through the date the search is conducted:

1. Any ALDACs, cables, guidance, standard operating procedures, or Foreign Affairs Manual (9 FAM) updates issued by the Bureau of Consular Affairs, or sent to posts in Mission China, concerning the implementation or scope of Presidential Proclamation 10043 ("Suspension of Entry as Nonimmigrants of Certain Students and Researchers From the People's Republic of China");
2. Any records establishing or revising criteria for identifying "entities that implement or support the PRC's military-civil fusion strategy" for purposes of PP 10043, and any list of such entities;
3. Any records concerning how two factors are to be considered when applying PP 10043: (a) the exception for applicants studying or conducting research in fields that would not contribute to military-civil fusion, and (b) degrees from U.S. institutions.

This request concerns general policy and guidance, not the issuance or refusal of any individual visa; INA § 222(f) therefore does not apply. Please release all reasonably segregable non-exempt portions and identify the exemption claimed for each redaction.

For reference, a related request for aggregate refusal statistics has been filed separately with the Department as F-2027-04026. This request seeks different records and is not a duplicate.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Ruowang Sun
